name: Jonathan (son of Kareah)
title: Commander after the fall of Jerusalem
summary: Jonathan, son of Kareah, was one of the commanders who came to the governor Gedaliah in Mizpah after the fall of Jerusalem, together with his brother Johanan.

keyEvents.title: Comes to Gedaliah in Mizpah
keyEvents.description: Jonathan and Johanan, sons of Kareah, came with the other commanders to Gedaliah in Mizpah after the fall of Jerusalem.
